result.semantics: Only distinct reciprocal source pair IDs qualify; known same-side pair conflicts are excluded. Each directed edge/mirror orbit is counted once, including self-loop and contralateral orbits. Signed asymmetry is (leftWeight-rightWeight)/(leftWeight+rightWeight); weighted summary is sum absolute differences / sum weights. Left is the source-left orientation when available, then target-left, otherwise a stable lexicographic canonical orientation. Counts are raw source observations after neuron-pair thresholding, not completeness-adjusted or causal evidence.
